construct: Effect modification occurs when the magnitude or direction of an exposure-outcome association differs across levels of a third variable. Unlike confounding, effect modification is a real feature of the relationship and should generally be described using stratum-specific effect estimates or an interaction term rather than simply adjusted away.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Substantially different, precise stratum-specific relative risks indicate that the effect of smoking differs by asbestos status; this is effect modification.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Asbestos could also be a confounder in some datasets, but heterogeneity of stratum-specific effects is the defining observation for effect modification and should be reported rather than averaged away.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: RR 6 versus 18 across strata directly demonstrates effect modification.
